title: South Korea is deploying thousands of ChatGPT-enabled social care robots to help elderly people; over-65s now account for ~20% of the country's 51M people (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: South Korea is deploying thousands of ChatGPT-enabled social care robots to help elderly people; over-65s now account for ~20% of the country's 51M people — South Korea's strained social care system turns to ChatGPT-enabled devices as population ages — NEW
